      Lychrel196.step n = natValue (inputWord xs k)

      digitPairSums ds = coefficientWord h c ∧ natValue ds = n

declarations.name: mem_numericFiber_canonical
declarations.signature:
theorem mem_numericFiber_canonical (h : List Nat) (c : Option Nat) (n : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ s ∈ coefficientWord h c, s ≤ 18) :
    n ∈ numericFiber h c ↔
      (∃ d, Canonical n d (coefficientWord h c).length) ∧
      Lychrel196.step n = natValue (coefficientWord h c)

declarations.name: mem_numericFiber
declarations.signature:
theorem mem_numericFiber (h : List Nat) (c : Option Nat) (n : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ s ∈ coefficientWord h c, s ≤ 18) :
    n ∈ numericFiber h c ↔
      decimalWidth n (coefficientWord h c).length ∧
      Lychrel196.step n = natValue (coefficientWord h c)

theorem length_numericFiber_cons (s : Nat) (h : List Nat) (c : Option Nat) :
    (numericFiber (s :: h) c).length =
      pairCount true s * centerCount c * natProduct (h.map (pairCount false))

theorem length_numericFiber_cons_le (s : Nat) (h : List Nat) (c : Option Nat) :

declarations.name: decodeNumerical
declarations.signature: def decodeNumerical (e : Nat → Nat) (W L : Nat) : Option (List Nat)

declarations.name: decodeNumerical_eq_some_iff_payload
declarations.signature:
theorem decodeNumerical_eq_some_iff_payload
    (Y : Nat) (e : Nat → Nat) (W L : Nat) (qs : List Nat)
    (htarget : Canonical Y e W) :
    decodeNumerical e W L = some qs ↔
      ∃ h, WidthChoice e W L h ∧ qs.length = L ∧
        PayloadSpec e L h (digitFn qs)

declarations.name: decodeNumerical_eq_some_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem decodeNumerical_eq_some_iff
    (Y : Nat) (e : Nat → Nat) (W L : Nat) (qs : List Nat)
    (htarget : Canonical Y e W) :
    decodeNumerical e W L = some qs ↔
      qs.length = L ∧ ∃ n d, 0 < n ∧ Canonical n d L ∧
        (∀ i, i < L → columnSum d L i = digitFn qs i) ∧ step n = Y

declarations.name: decodeNumerical_isSome_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem decodeNumerical_isSome_iff
    (Y : Nat) (e : Nat → Nat) (W L : Nat) (htarget : Canonical Y e W) :
    (decodeNumerical e W L).isSome = true ↔
      ∃ n d, 0 < n ∧ Canonical n d L ∧ step n = Y
